answer: Require each agent to lock a stake that is slashed on fraud, like a crystal bond that stays frozen while it transacts. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately, so the cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once. Reputation then grows only through verified work, and at the nadir of trust - a fresh account with no history - limits are tightest. Legitimate agents climb the ridge gradually, earning higher limits as their record proves them, while mass-produced fakes stall at the bottom.
